about: Clown Applying Makeup is a four-step tutorial photo strip of a man turning himself into a clown. Step one is the white base, step two adds painted eyes and red lips, step three is a rainbow wig being pulled on, and the last shows the finished look with a red nose. Each blank space to the left of a photo holds one stage of a bad decision or a self-deceiving belief, so the person gets more ridiculous with every line. By the final panel they are a complete clown, which is the internet's way of saying you fooled yourself.
origin: The photos come from a 2015 YouTube clown makeup tutorial posted by a costume company. The step-by-step stills became a meme format in 2018-2019.
usage:
There are four boxes, one beside each photo from top to bottom. Write a chain of reasoning in which each step is slightly more delusional than the last, and save the most self-assured line for the full clown with the red nose.

It works best in the first person: procrastination, trusting a game studio again, believing an ex will change, buying a stock after it already spiked. Keep each step short and make the progression feel logical in the moment, because the joke is how reasonable every individual step sounds.
